alerts.title: Road to Rim Village is Temporarily CLOSED.
alerts.description: The road from Park Headquarters to Rim Village is temporarily CLOSED due to heavy snow from the current weather system. Roads are very slick and covered with slush. Please use extreme caution if driving in the park. All Oregon snow tire and chain laws apply.

alerts.title: Rim Drive and North Entrance Road are CLOSED for the Season.
alerts.description: Winter road closures are in effect. The park's North Entrance Road, most of the Rim Drive, Cloudcap, and Pinnacles Road are closed to automobiles. The park's West and South Entrances are open, as is Hwy 62 through the park. These roads will not reopen until mid-June or early July depending on the snowpack.

alerts.title: Cleetwood Cove Trail is CLOSED for Rehabilitation
alerts.description: The Cleetwood Cove Trail is CLOSED for construction. This critical project will fully rehabilitate the trail and marina to ensure safe access to the lake, provide a much-improved visitor experience, and protect the environment.
